study.question: Does ordering inverse-norm scale donors by their scalar value recover adjacent-versus-half rotation AUC while increasing donor history-position/age displacement? The observed history-adjacent minus history-half AUC is +0.00026890848463556605 at seed 42, but short displacement and high own/donor correlation co-occur. This bounded replacement contrast probes scalar proximity without prescribing history proximity; it cannot establish robustness or fully separate gradient covariance from optimization.
study.hypothesis: Conditional on successful manipulation, preserving approximate own-to-donor scalar scale association can support the ranking recovery without requiring a temporally nearby donor. Within each impression, stable ascending inverse-norm order followed by a one-position circular rotation should yield smaller own-scale error and better validation AUC than a half-rotation in that same order, even if its temporal/index donor gaps exceed chronological adjacency. This is a falsifiable local optimization hypothesis, not a new normalization derivative or a semantic claim.

study.proposed_difference: Add two standalone modes: scale_adjacent_tangent and scale_half_tangent. Detach inverse radii, stable-sort eligible events ascending by inverse radius (ties in supplied position order), rotate that sorted list by one or floor(n/2), and gather each donor inverse radius back to its recipient. J_j=s_donor*(I-u_j*u_j^T) for regular eligible events. Preserve below-floor J=1000I and masked full J. Add one chronology-half bridge with the same module body and diagnostics; reuse verified chronology-adjacent incumbent as fourth factorial cell. No new learned parameter, coefficient sweep, action-group variant, optimizer or supervision.
predictions: Manipulation: at each available checkpoint the label-free four-rule diagnostic should show scale-adjacent lower own/donor absolute scale error and higher within-history centered correlation than scale-half, while having larger donor position and age gaps than history-adjacent. Report all cells and ties; if gaps/correlation do not separate as predicted, performance alone cannot test the proposed explanation.

Primary contrast: AUC(scale_adjacent)-AUC(scale_half)>0 under frozen host seed 42. Report delta versus history-adjacent, history-half, full and fixed anchors with Logloss and measured costs; no assumed minimum or equivalence margin.

If approximate scale association can substitute for chronological locality in this implementation, scale-adjacent should recover AUC relative to history-half despite larger temporal displacement. Recovery below history-adjacent is partial evidence only; failure of strict superiority to the incumbent is not itself mechanism refutation.

Order-by-offset interaction: report [AUC(scale_adjacent)-AUC(scale_half)]-[AUC(history_adjacent)-AUC(history_half_bridge)] without a predetermined sign. It quantifies this factorial contrast, not a decomposition of one fitted model.

At identical parameters forwards/logits must match full unit normalization; scale multisets, eligible per-row sums/squared sums and invalid/floor behavior must be preserved. Parameter count should remain 17130275 conditional on unchanged meta; actual host costs and actual tensor VJPs remain unmeasured locally.
falsifiers: Nonfinite outputs, changed forward logits, illegal donors, changed mask/floor behavior, VJP mismatch, or failed scale conservation suspend mechanism attribution and require a charged repair or stop.

If scale-adjacent does not preserve substantially higher correlation/lower scalar error than scale-half, or does not increase temporal displacement over history adjacency on supplied diagnostics, the intended intervention is inconclusive; do not assert separation or start an offset sweep.

If manipulation succeeds but scale-adjacent has nonpositive AUC delta versus scale-half and history-half, the proposed local scalar-association sufficiency account is weakened. One seed/implementation cannot refute it generally.
If history-half bridge does not reproduce AUC/Logloss of r0009-history_reassigned under unchanged protocol, stop mixed-round attribution and audit source/recipe/checkpoints before comparisons.
